headline: Dollar price hits 128.50 BDT in open market as rates rise in banks
summary: The US dollar has surged in both the open market and banking channels, driving up import costs and other foreign currency rates.
details: The US dollar has seen a sudden price hike in Bangladesh, reaching 128.50 BDT in the open market. Banking channels have also experienced a rise, with banks selling cash dollars at approximately 126.50 BDT.
caption:
The US dollar has surged to 128.50 BDT in the open market, driving up import costs across the board.

headline: Garment workers demand 30,000 taka minimum wage in Mirpur protests
summary: Protests by garment workers in Mirpur led to road blockades, clashes with security personnel, and vandalism of factories and markets.
details: Garment workers in Dhaka's Mirpur area staged protests on Saturday demanding a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 taka. The demonstrations led to road blockades and vandalism of several markets and garment factories.
caption:
Garment workers in Mirpur demand 30,000 taka minimum wage, leading to road blockades and vandalism.

Garment workers in Dhaka's Mirpur area staged protests on Saturday demanding a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 taka. The demonstrations led to road blockades and vandalism of several markets and garment factories.
